اعتصمتا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَمَتَا (iʕtaṣamatā) /iʕ.ta.sˤa.ma.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# اُعْتُصِمَتَا (uʕtuṣimatā) /uʕ.tu.sˤi.ma.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
